attempts.summary: Configured a dedicated node2 uploader key and node1 forced-command ingest identity. Each SSH submission is stored byte-for-byte as a separate atomic receipt. Commands, shells, PTYs, and forwarding are blocked. Existing data, RHEL 9.8, and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8 were preserved. Both nodes passed one-at-a-time reboot persistence testing.
